description: Check a project's Vinktar install from the data that actually arrived: events and errors received, users identified, releases and environments tagged, source maps for the latest release, items the SDK dropped, and key events described. Each gap comes with the next step. Call it after installing, and again after each fix, until nothing is left to do. Setup call: never counted against the agent allowance.

project.description: Project handle (as in list_projects) or id. Optional when this connection is limited to one project or the workspace has only one.

title: Get setup status
